localChanges: Computer players' Fighters and Bombers now head back to one of their cities before their fuel runs out, instead of crashing (closes #73).

log: A Fighter or Bomber no longer takes a move or attack that would leave it unable to reach one of its player's cities before its fuel runs out. Carriers aren't counted, because an aircraft can't board one yet.
The client now also accepts the StrategyNoteRegistry and WorkedTileRegistry, as optional trailing constructor arguments.
